_meta.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

derived_fields.area_share: Crop's share of the state's total sown area across the 22 modelled crops
derived_fields.tier: major >= 5% area share, minor >= 0.1%, else negligible
derived_fields.yield_t_ha: Area-weighted mean yield across districts and years
derived_fields.yield_cv: Coefficient of variation of annual yield - the empirical risk measure
derived_fields.yield_units_ok: False where source production is not in tonnes (coconut in nuts, cotton in bales); the curated national figure is used instead
